manualReview.scope: Second text/design pass after content revision; same assistant, not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Two walking-group members exchange countries without introducing unrelated grammar. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Country names and the from construction remain within early A1 scope.

distractorQuality.evidence: A04/A06 contrast the countries of two named roles; A07 requires the learner to form the question, not repeat their country answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Two walking-group members exchange countries without introducing unrelated grammar.

difficultyFit.evidence: Country names and the from construction remain within early A1 scope.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Audio reconstruction is labelled supported practice; the final task removes the model. A04/A06 contrast the countries of two named roles; A07 requires the learner to form the question, not repeat their country answer.

transferQuality.evidence: A04/A06 contrast the countries of two named roles; A07 requires the learner to form the question, not repeat their country answer. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: Two walking-group members exchange countries without introducing unrelated grammar. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
